scope: Explicit user-option evidence before AI attribute edits; bounded ambiguous combo/one-person catalog inquiry context; pending included beverage value selection; generic purchase slots and read-only inquiries within a joint replacement/purchase plan.

baseline.method: Offline isolated image runs with injected agent actions / deterministic full-router scenarios. No live model equivalence or historical deployment timing inferred.

limits: Normal inquiry entry is bounded to ambiguous combo and serving-size questions; not a replacement for every legacy catalog route.
Mixed generic purchases use available full-token catalog prefixes/categories, maximum eight choices; uncertain requests still clarify.
Subset-unit product replacement and broader natural owner references retain previous scope.
No paid model/channel evaluation or real orders. Passing mocked tests does not certify the pilot.
Production promotion and Kamppo migration are pending.
developmentFindings: Seven initial controlled failures were present in both current production and staging images.
Catalog validity did not establish customer selection; arbitrary allowed option edits are now rejected.
Generic purchase terms did not resolve within mixed plans; presentation and flavor are now separate pending choices.
Singular sabor failed an early new regex; covered and fixed before final validation.
Explicit #code must precede numeric list-position parsing.
One initial acceptance oracle incorrectly expected defaults instead of the existing required Pollo choice; corrected without runtime change.
Two added cross-restaurant tests lacked an orders mock; fixed fixture setup without runtime change.

Interrupted first global attempt after an existing accompaniment inquiry was incorrectly routed into the new ambiguous selector. Entry now requires an actual matching catalog prefix; original full continuation and two new boundaries pass before the final frozen-source run.

A subsequent development global exposed six existing side-swap acceptance failures: a general bare affirmative clarification intercepted valid pending offers. Removed that general interceptor and retained source-grounding at the action guard. Ten original side-swap cases and 2822 related cases pass on final sources.

A development related run used an unsupported plural Jest 29 flag, selected the full inventory and was stopped. The singular --testPathPattern selected exactly 42 suites; only that successful run is credited.
nextPriorities: Broader rephrasing and explicit abandonment of an information thread without losing checkout.
Natural owner references and subset-unit product replacement mixed with new purchases.
Controlled live-model evaluation under the shared remaining budget before claiming production equivalence.
globalDevelopmentAttempts: Two interrupted frozen development attempts, neither credited as global approval. Final source run is recorded separately.
